title: News/Media Alliance Applauds AI Bot Transparency Bill Introduction
content: Representative Laurel Lee and Representative Valerie Foushee introduced the Stealth Bot Prohibition Act, a bipartisan piece of transparency legislation that would require AI stealth crawlers to disclose their identity and purpose.
